attempts.rationale: Robust baseline: unstable ranking (tau=-0.045) and 8 correlated error groups favor a distributional robust combination over any single model or weighted scheme. Trim 20% to guard against outlier model predictions at each horizon.
Unstable rankings (tau=-0.045) and robust diagnosis hint suggest median over full pool may outperform trimmed_mean by being less sensitive to a few outlier models per window.

Test whether inverse-error weighting beats trimmed_mean by more aggressively downweighting the tail models (NaiveSeasonal, NaiveMovingAverage) while upweighting ARIMA/rf/DWT_catboost, given unstable ranking favors soft weighting over hard trimming.
DBA directly optimizes combination weights for prediction accuracy rather than using a heuristic like inverse_error; useful contrast given unstable rankings and the robust combination hint.
Per-horizon top-3 on top-7 SMAPE pool: tests whether horizon-specific model selection on a diverse focused pool captures the unstable ranking better than full-pool DBA
Softer weighting than inverse_error; more robust to unstable ranking (tau=-0.045) and strong seasonality/trend where no model dominates consistently across windows
Simple unweighted mean over all 19 models as a robust baseline; tests whether equal diversification across 8 correlation groups matches DBA/weighted under unstable ranking
DBA on top-6 pool to test if less correlated redundancy improves the optimal blend vs full 19-model pool
Strong seasonality (0.9999) + unstable ranking suggests different models win at different horizon steps; per-horizon one-hot selection tests this vs DBA's single weight vector
Robust trimmed mean on the top-6 RMSE pool to test if removing extreme forecasts (contested trend direction) improves on DBA leader, given strong trend+seasonality and unstable ranking

Meta-model weights use cross-series knowledge to weight models, testing whether dataset-level patterns help with this strongly seasonal, trend-dominated series where local ranking is unstable (tau=-0.045)
Test if median on the same top-7 pool4 as the DBA leader captures similar robustness, isolating pool selection effect from DBA method effect

decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9655. Series context: trend strength 0.9991 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.045); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.604.
